sharedDirection: Finished original illustrated literary book front cover; portrait 2:3, flat edge-to-edge artwork; prominent exact serif title across upper half and exact smaller author at bottom; generous margins, readable typography, elegant original design with paper texture; no mockup, spine, publisher logos, or extra text. Titles and authors are taken verbatim from manifest.json.

subjects.the-great-gatsby: Midnight navy, muted teal and gold Art Deco mansion and slender fountain at night, glowing windows, a single green light across dark water and radiating geometric lines. Original literary illustration, no eyes motif.
subjects.the-secret-garden: Ivory, forest green, sage, dusty rose and butter yellow. Old green wooden garden door framed by climbing roses, fern fronds, ivy, small birds and antique brass key. Botanical storybook gouache.
subjects.jane-eyre: Distant Victorian manor on windswept moors under a dramatic sky, plum purple, slate and pale parchment; expressive linocut and watercolor literary illustration.
subjects.little-women: Warmly lit Victorian parlor table with books, sewing, four cups of tea and a snowy window; warm rust, ochre, sage and cream; hand-painted gouache.
subjects.the-time-machine: Copper and deep turquoise; intricate brass time machine dial surrounded by spiraling clockwork and a distant futuristic skyline; retro science fiction engraving.
subjects.the-picture-of-dorian-gray: Emerald green, black and aged gold; ornate empty gilded portrait frame with a single pale rose and dark painterly shadow; Gothic still life, no human faces.
subjects.a-room-with-a-view: Sun-washed terracotta, turquoise and warm cream; open Italian window framing Florence rooftops and the Duomo, cypress trees and linen curtain; Mediterranean gouache.
subjects.dracula: Dark crimson, charcoal black, moonlit ivory; jagged Gothic castle above a Carpathian mountain forest, dramatic red moon and stylized bats; atmospheric woodcut.
subjects.the-call-of-the-wild: Icy turquoise, dark spruce and pale amber; husky-like sled dog in profile on a rocky ridge, snowy Yukon wilderness and aurora beyond; painterly vintage adventure illustration.
subjects.anne-of-green-gables: Original flat literary cover, charming gouache painting of a white farmhouse with green gables beneath flowering apple trees, winding country lane, Prince Edward Island pastoral landscape; fresh green, warm coral and cream; no people.
